conflict_resolutions.EMPTY_CATALOG_NOTE_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH_CU: The only observation, an Office of the Federal Register catalog record with empty note text, neither shows the order in force nor ended, and it is not used. The status rests on the order's own text (one self-executing amendment instruction, spent on issue, whose inserted paragraph states a period ending June 30, 1940) and on the bounded searches, which found no citation of the order.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: Executive Order 8187 contains one self-executing instruction to add a paragraph to Subdivision VI of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules, so its command was performed on issue (1939-06-29) and the whole order was read in the held original. The inserted paragraph covers only July 1, 1939 to June 30, 1940 by its own words. No continuing command, deadline or later citation by number was found, so the order was not in force on 2026-10-14.
